svg.title: Lost in the Middle shows position-dependent recall that varies by model and task, not a fixed penalty for middle-positioned evidence.
svg.desc: A qualitative bar sketch of Liu et al.'s multi-document QA and key-value retrieval results: recall was often stronger when relevant evidence appeared near the start or end of context and weaker in the middle. The pattern's size and shape changed across models, tasks, and context lengths, so the diagram argues for testing position as a variable rather than assuming a universal attention curve.
